title: Race, Ethnicity and Disability
about: The combined race and ethnicity question of OMB's 2024 standards (SPD 15), with its detailed categories and write-ins, and the six disability questions of HHS's 2011 data standard (the American Community Survey's). Federal agencies must use SPD 15 by September 28, 2029; UDS and Title X reporting still use the earlier categories until 2029, so map these answers before reporting there, and note that Middle Eastern or North African has no earlier category.

source.name: OMB Statistical Policy Directive No. 15 (89 FR 22182, March 29, 2024); HHS Implementation Guidance on Data Collection Standards (October 31, 2011), disability status

items: Are you deaf or do you have serious difficulty hearing?
Are you blind or do you have serious difficulty seeing, even when wearing glasses?
Because of a physical, mental, or emotional condition, do you have serious difficulty concentrating, remembering, or making decisions? (5 years old or older)
Do you have serious difficulty walking or climbing stairs? (5 years old or older)
Do you have difficulty dressing or bathing? (5 years old or older)
Because of a physical, mental, or emotional condition, do you have difficulty doing errands alone such as visiting a doctor's office or shopping? (15 years old or older)
